mentions.name: Skill evaluator tool
mentions.description: An automated skill evaluator that runs an AI skill through test suites, then tweaks the skill context and runs it again, iteratively self-improving the skill until it greatly outperforms its first version.
mentions.problem: First versions of skills are typically much worse than what the tool produces after automated self improvement.
mentions.source_excerpt: Built a skill evaluator tool that runs a skill through test suites and then tweaks the skill context and runs again. Its been pretty effective to be honest, almost all skills you do the first version is laughable compared to the one you get after this automated self improvement.
mentions.author: jhogendorn
